summary: Completed testing of FamFocus Hub Iteration 8 - Drag-and-Drop Chore Scheduler feature. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with Calendar View and Children View modes.
critical_code_review_comments: ChoreScheduler.js uses @dnd-kit/core for drag-and-drop - properly implemented
Calendar View shows 7-day week with droppable day columns
Children View shows child rows with droppable zones
Child selector in Calendar View allows selecting which child to schedule for
Save Schedule button creates chores via POST /api/chores
Clear Schedule button removes all local assignments
Sidebar has Chore Scheduler link for parents only
Parent Dashboard has Manual Scheduler button linking to /chore-scheduler
seed_data_creation: Test parent and child users created with parent_id relationship for family members API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chore Scheduler feature fully tested. Uses @dnd-kit/core for drag-and-drop. Calendar View and Children View both working. Child selector requires parent_id field on child users to appear in family members list.

features: Page loads at /chore-scheduler route
Requires authentication (redirects to login if not authenticated)
Shows 'Chore Scheduler' title with 'Drag and drop to assign chores' subtitle
Available Chores panel shows 10 default chore types
Each chore item shows name and points (e.g., 'Dishes 10 pts')
Chore items have drag handles (GripVertical icon)
Calendar View button toggles to calendar mode
Shows 'This Week' with 7 day columns (today + 6 days)
Day columns show day name (WED, THU, etc.) and date number
Today's column has accent color highlight
Empty columns show 'Drop chores here' placeholder
Assigned chores show chore name and child name
Child selector shows when children exist in family
By Children button toggles to children view mode
Shows child cards with avatar, name, and chore count
Each child has droppable zone for chores
Shows 'No children in your family yet' when no children
Assigned chores show chore name and date
Shows 'Scheduling for:' label in Calendar View
Displays child buttons with avatar and name/nickname
Selected child has primary color highlight
Clicking child button selects that child for scheduling
Save Schedule button - creates chores via API
Save button disabled when no new assignments
Clear button - removes all local assignments
Clear shows 'Schedule cleared' toast notification
Back button - navigates to /dashboard
Back button navigates to /dashboard
Sidebar 'Chore Scheduler' link navigates to /chore-scheduler
Parent Dashboard 'Manual Scheduler' button navigates to /chore-scheduler
Chore Scheduler menu item visible in sidebar for parents
Uses GripVertical icon with teal color
Highlights when on /chore-scheduler route
Manual Scheduler button visible on Parent Dashboard
Shows 'Drag & drop chores' description
Uses teal/emerald gradient icon
Clicking navigates to /chore-scheduler
